_help: Scene list for the 10-feature demo video. tools/render-video.sh renders it in the render VM through tools/marketing/video/render.swift and encodes the clips. Each scene opens with a title card (cardMs), then runs its steps against its fixture. Step keys: stage (what is on screen: launcher, notch, break-notice, break-overlay, pick-screen, rex-overview, notes, notes-iphone, settings), type (text typed one character per frame into `into`: search, form, chat; it appends to what is there), key (return, down, up, left, right, tab, escape, cmd-k, cmd-p), hook (a fixture action in render.swift), cursor (an anchor name or [x, y] on the 1080 canvas, moved over moveMs), click (a pressed cursor, then the hook), hideCursor, reveal (the notch panel's growing edge drawn over that many ms, from its size before the step), holdMs (how long the frame after the step shows), keyMs (per typed character), repeat. All data shown is fictional.

scenes.title: Focus mode
scenes.caption: Hide distracting apps and blank blocked sites while you work toward one goal.
scenes.note: On a MacBook with a notch; otherwise a floating bar or the menu bar.

scenes.note: Off by default. Shown on the Standard setting.
